name: aix-chat
description: Chat with Rouvr to scope and run Objectives with real execution (explore → approve → mutate/verify).

chatParticipants.name: aix
chatParticipants.description: Discuss and scope a new Objective with AIX

aix.orchestratorUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of AIX-Frontend / AIX Orchestrator. Defaults to `http://localhost:3000` (the BFF that signs gateway assertions for the backend).

aix.authUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of `hyeve-auth-service` (used for login and token refresh). Defaults to `http://localhost:8222`.

aix.tenantId.description: Default tenant ID to sign in with (prefilled, editable at sign-in time). Also sent as X-Hyeve-Tenant-Id on API calls.

aix.repositoryId.markdownDescription: Which approved repository (a key in the backend's `OBJECTIVE_CYCLE_REPOSITORY_ROOTS`) admitted objectives target. Leave blank to use the open workspace folder's name.

aix.integrationUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of `hyeve-integration-service` (its OpenAI-compatible route `/api/integrations/llm/openai/v1/chat/completions` is used). Required for the AIX model to appear in Agent Mode's model picker — without it, no AIX model is offered rather than one that fails on every request.

aix.model.description: Model name to pass through to hyeve-integration-service (e.g. an openrouter/... id it recognizes). Leave blank to use the service's own default.
